$comment: Schema and example for docs/ROADMAP.json. Sprint skill reads/writes this file as the source of truth for all sprint tracking.

$rules.user_story_format: {役割}として、{やりたいこと}をしたい。なぜなら、{理由・価値}だから。 — Task decompositions ('〜を実装する') are not valid stories.
$rules.acceptance_criteria: Write as verifiable user behavior ('〜ができる'), not implementation ('〜が実装されている'). GUI stories get Playwright test scenarios from gui-spec.
$rules.sprint_id: Random 6-char lowercase hex with 'S' prefix: Sa3f9c2, Sb1e4d8, Sc7d2a1. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 3` and prepend 'S'. Random IDs prevent collisions when multiple worktrees create Sprints in parallel. IDs are permanent — never change or reuse. Creation/execution order is tracked via the execution_order array, NOT the ID itself. Existing sequential IDs (S001, S002...) from older projects remain valid and must not be renamed.
$rules.user_review_required_constraint: If a story has user_review_required: true, its status MUST NOT be 'done' (only 'needs_user_review' is allowed pending explicit user approval). Enforced by sprint-done-judgment.md Guard 1 — see references/sprint-done-judgment.md.
$rules.needs_user_review_semantics: needs_user_review marks Stories that completed implementation but failed one or more of the 6 done-judgment guards (user_review_required, nil-injection mock, mock-mode smoke, priority_rule 9 exception validity, call-path existence, deferred-comment residue). These Stories surface at the next sprint demo for explicit user decision.

review_extensions.$comment: Optional fields added by autopilot Review Mode (§2.7). All are OPTIONAL and back-compatible — absent ⇒ the default interpretation below. Per §2.9.3, write a field ONLY when it carries meaning; do not add null/empty fields to every Story. See ../sprint/references/REOPEN_SCHEMA.json.
review_extensions.story.added_in_review: Milestone label (e.g. "M02") when a fix-Story was added to an already-done Sprint via Review Mode ②. Absent ⇒ the Story was originally planned.
review_extensions.story.reopened_at: ISO timestamp when a done Story was re-opened via Review Mode ① (or manual_retroactive). Absent ⇒ never re-opened.
review_extensions.acceptance_criteria[].reopened_at: ISO timestamp when a pass AC was flipped back to fail on Sprint re-open. Absent ⇒ a normal AC; pass means pass.
review_extensions.sprint.corrections: Optional array of correction records ({type, milestone, ref} where type is one of reopen | fix_story | direction_change) appended when Review Mode touches this Sprint. Absent ⇒ treated as an empty array (no corrections).

$rules.progress_rules: Only one sprint can be in_progress at a time. A story is done only when all tasks are done. A sprint is done only when all stories are done; if any story is needs_user_review, the sprint is partial.
$rules.milestone: Set to true at natural review points. sprint plan and sprint roadmap manage milestone placement.
